issues: The heading hierarchy is illogical and non-sequential, with h3s appearing before h1s and h1s appearing before h2s without proper nesting.
Multiple h1 headings are present on the page, which violates the principle of a single main topic per page and confuses screen reader users.
Numerous empty headings (h2: "", h3: "") are used, providing no semantic value and creating navigation obstacles.
Headings are skipped (e.g., h1 followed by h3s, or h3s without an h2 parent), breaking the expected hierarchical flow.

Several headings are repetitive ("Larg nga përditshmëria!", "Ajër i pastër dhe peisazhe të bukura natyrore!", "Një komunë e gjallë e strehuar në zemër të Pollogut!") making it difficult to distinguish content sections.

missingSections: The page lacks a single, overarching h1 heading that clearly reflects the main topic of the page, 'Komuna e Zhelinës – Faqja Zyrtare'.
suggestions: Implement a single h1 heading that accurately represents the main topic of the page, such as 'Komuna e Zhelinës'.
Establish a logical and sequential heading hierarchy (h1 > h2 > h3) without skipping levels.
Remove all empty headings to improve navigation and semantic clarity.
Ensure all headings are descriptive, concise, and unique, clearly indicating the content of their respective sections.
Consolidate or rephrase repetitive promotional headings into a single, appropriately leveled section.
Rephrase generic headings like 'Të Ndryshme' to be more specific and informative.
Consider if the long h3 'Kulturë. Debate. Sport. Rekreacion. Argëtim.' would be better presented as a concise heading with the details in the body text, or as a list.
items.summary: The page's heading structure is critically flawed due to multiple h1s, an illogical hierarchy, and numerous empty or repetitive headings, severely hindering screen reader navigation and content comprehension.
